condition: Congenital adrenal hyperplasia due to 21-hydroxylase deficiency
findings_a: CYP21A2 deletion from depth and PSV sites (CYP21A2 1 copies, RCCX module total 3 of 4): the 30 kb chimeric deletion pattern; unconfirmed, short reads
findings_b: possible CYP21A2 conversion at P30L,I172N (CYP21A2 0 copies, RCCX module total 4 of 4, PSV sites); unconfirmed, short reads
explanation: Both partners carry a change in CYP21A2, linked to Congenital adrenal hyperplasia due to 21-hydroxylase deficiency (autosomal recessive). A child who inherits the change of each parent can have the condition: 1 in 2 per pregnancy.
